name: @nexus/execution-core
description: Phase 11A-1 Execution Core Foundation — pure, deterministic, fail-closed derivation of execution intent/plan/state (intent, plan, orders, fills, positions, lifecycle, immutable audit) from already-served TradingDecision + TradePlan outputs (the single source of truth). ZERO broker dependency; IO-free, clock-injected, replay-safe. Recomputes NOTHING the decision/plan already carry (direction, confidence, entry, stop, targets, R:R, readiness are consumed VERBATIM). The only component allowed to create, track and close orders.
